scope: singles, files for 2010 onward, staged dump as of 2026-09-22
link_rule: exact player-name pair after normalisation (accents, case and punctuation removed; tokens sorted so "Zhang Zhizhen" equals "Zhizhen Zhang"), inside a date window measured from the tournament week (qualifying rows may precede it by up to 10 days, other rows by up to 3), nearest tournament week wins and ties count as ambiguous. No fuzzy matching, so link rates are lower bounds. The provisional canonical table (Sackmann rows plus Tennis My Life rows Sackmann lacks) is a measuring device, not the merged database.
